definition_used: One or more journals/publishers misunderstood one or more parts of a message sent to and/or from one or more journals/publishers.
caution: Miscommunication is a process error, not a direct content flaw; it may affect editorial handling or transparency but does not inherently indicate unreliable research content or authorship issues.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a journal/publisher misunderstanding in communication, which is an editorial process error (editorial_peer_review_governance) and may impact transparency or due process (post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight). No direct evidence of research content problems or attribution issues.
